highLevelGoal: Reopen Orca-Strator V1 as NOT YET QUALIFIED and perform a deep runtime-integration hardening campaign until the real production path works end-to-end: watcher->loop->executor->result->loop->Sol wake wired in production, correct Windows/WSL/Git/browser/recovery/control semantics, and a real qualification tier that proves the pipeline with real Git, real child-process executors, and durable result manifests.

checkpoint.summary: Hardening sweep through all 18 review items. Fix #1: buildApp now auto-starts watcherService (enabled repos watched, disabled unwatched, shutdown stops timers, idempotent). Fix #2: production buildApp qualification gate added (Q.APP.1) using real temp git + bare remote via the API seam with only ChatGPT driver mocked; proves watcher->loop->real harness->result->Sol wake without manual graph assembly. Fix #3: wall-clock ceiling separated from executor watchdog (watchdog disabled by default, ceiling is run-level DRAINING->CEILING_REACHED without killing actor; accelerated-clock tests prove executor not killed). Fix #4: Stop is graceful DRAINING until actor boundary (truthful UI), Emergency Kill remains immediate. Fix #5: ExecutorExitReason first-class (NORMAL_EXIT/PAUSED/EMERGENCY_KILLED/WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT/SPAWN_FAILURE), PAUSED not promoted to RECOVERY_REQUIRED, Resume restarts SAME dispatch with recovery=true, slow harness (ORCA_SLOW_MS) proves pause/resume/stop/kill isolation machine-qualified. Fix #6: result semantic validation enforces dispatchId/runId/iteration/baseSha/executor cli+model+environment + resultSha ancestry + manifest committed + remote main ancestry; remote-unverifiable becomes retryable postflight. Fix #7: nonzero exit still inspects valid BLOCKED/NEEDS_HUMAN/FAILED manifests; zero without manifest remains invalid. Fix #8: ExecutorRunner handshake (awaitSpawn resolves on spawn, rejects on pre-spawn error) enables genuine 3x launch retry; terminal callback fires exactly once. Fix #9: BrowserManager keeps page alive, Sol operation coordinator (runId/iteration/wakeId/deadline/retry), 20-min timeout with one retry then SOL_STALLED, per-repo page lifecycle (one repo failure does not close others). Fix #10: SolWakeSubmitter detects busy/auth/CAPTCHA via selectors+bodyText (input-only) with bounded dismiss. Fix #11: provisioning.ts + GET /api/system/provisioning exposes Chromium ready/missing (Chromium verified present on this machine). Fix #12: H.4 Sol-control marker round-trip machine-qualified via Q.APP.1 second half. Real Kimi 0.34.0 (-m/-p) and Codex 0.147.0 (codex exec -m --json) verified and profiles corrected.
